answers.answer: Kapolei High School Classrooms Renovation; DOE Job No. Q82227-21; 91-5007 Kapolei High School Parkway, Kapolei, Hawaii 96707. The stated work is a modernization build-out within existing school buildings, including new finishes, fixtures, and equipment.

answers.answer: Building I first floor: 4 months; Building G first floor: 4 months; Building G second floor: 4 months. The work is sequential and only one floor is to be vacated at a time.
Building G is Type V-A, fully sprinklered; occupancy groups E, B, and S-1; two stories; automatic fire sprinkler system throughout.

answers.answer: Code 1: 3-5/8-inch metal stud at 16 inches on center. Code 2: 6-inch metal stud at 16 inches on center. Code 21: 8-inch CMU, solid grouted. Code 22: existing 8-inch CMU. Interior stud framing and furring is 16 inches on center unless noted otherwise.
answers.source: PCD drawings PDF page 12, sheet A3.00

answers.answer: Doors are 1-3/4 inches thick unless noted otherwise; handles are lever type and ADA compliant; relite glazing and stops occur on the corridor side unless noted otherwise.
answers.source: PCD drawings PDF page 24, sheet A5.01

answers.answer: Flooring and flooring-color transitions are centered under doors where required. Door and relite frames are painted PT2 unless noted otherwise, with the frame color approved by the architect. Gypsum-board ceilings are painted PT1 unless noted otherwise.
answers.source: PCD drawings PDF page 16, sheet A3.40

answers.answer: At the existing wide-flange beam, use a top track matching the stud size with one #10 screw at each leg, and three #10 screws through no more than two layers of gypsum board at each zee. Repair and repatch gypsum board to match UL P516. Provide acoustic sealant at each side and around the perimeter in accordance with Section 07900.
answers.source: PCD drawings PDF page 69, ASK 001.2 / RFI 016 detail referenced to A4.01

answers.answer: Support rectangular duct at 4-foot intervals. Round duct uses 3/8-inch hanger rods and a 1-inch by 1/8-inch two-piece hanger; duct straps may replace hanger rods in concealed locations.
answers.source: PCD drawings PDF page 88, sheet M5.01

answers.answer: 12 months: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 months. The areas are constructed sequentially and only one floor is vacated at a time.
222 calendar days: 589 - 367 = 222 days outside the stated on-site duration.
Punch-list delay: $200 per calendar day (10% x $2,000). Closing-document delay: $100 per calendar day (5% x $2,000).
